title: Problems with gas stovetops | weak, dirty and dangerous
summary: Food YouTuber Adam Ragusea argues that gas stovetops are weaker than electric burners, dirty to clean, and a health risk from indoor air pollution. He cites Consumer Reports ratings and a literature review on gas stove health effects.
why: Cited as an accessible overview of the case against gas cooktops in threads on cooking, induction and indoor air quality.

quote.text: Great coverage of this entire issue
